Messages.Body:
Journal of Hrorsh
Unique equipment. Salubri. burn option.

When this Salubri performs a successful action, put a counter on this
card. Burn these counters if this card is moved. You may remove this
ready Salubri from the game to move these counters to your pool (not
usable during an action).

Does the successful action to get the journal put a counter on the
journal?
